intro.label: Approach
intro.statement: Each session is an unhurried space to notice what your body *already knows* and choose, calmly, what comes next.
body: I am Helena Prado. I work with people who arrive tired of rushing, with a body asking for attention.
My work brings together integrative practices and careful listening. There is no set formula: every session starts from how you are that day.
intro.demoNote: Helena Prado is a fictional character created for this demo.

services.label: Services
services.title: Four windows onto the *same* pause.
services.intro: Each practice opens a different view. In our first conversation, we find the one that fits where you are right now.

experience.label: The session
experience.title: How light moves through a *session*
experience.intro: Four moments, from arriving to heading home. No hurry and no set formula.

steps.title: Arriving
steps.text: A cup of tea, a few minutes of conversation and room to say how you are arriving.

steps.title: Pausing
steps.text: Breath and body awareness, to leave the rush of the day at the door.

steps.title: Practice
steps.text: The chosen technique, guided at your pace and adjusted whenever you need.

steps.title: Integrating
steps.text: Time to come back slowly and talk about what the session left with you.

closing.title: Begin your moment of *care*.
closing.text: The first conversation comes with no commitment: tell me how you are and we'll decide together where to start.
